card.licenceNote: Original release listed as CC0 1.0 by Meta-Album (OpenML d/44242) and TensorFlow Datasets; some mirrors carry other licences. Images are fetched at run time and never committed.
card.domainNote: Single detached leaves of tomato, potato, pepper, maize, squash, cherry and grape photographed on a plain background. Not field photos, and not any of the six Thai herbs.

notCovered.ROOT_ROT: root rot shows at the stem base and roots; the dataset holds leaf photos only
notCovered.WILT: wilt shows on the whole plant; the dataset holds detached leaves only
